senses.gloss: f. (סָבַב) transfer of property from tribe to tribe (interch. with הֶסֵּבָּה).
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 111b">B. Bath. 111ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>סִיבַּת הבעל</he>, v. <cite ref="E00697"><he>הֶסֵבָּה</he> II</cite>.

Ib. 159ᵇ נאמרה ס׳ בבן נאמרה ס׳ בבעל (Ms. M. הסיבה) the transfer is spoken of (as forbidden) concerning the son succeeding his mother and the husband succeeding his wife; a. fr.—[Bibl. Hebr. סִבָּה: arrangement, divine dispensation; in later Hebr.: turn, misfortune; in philos. literature: cause.]
